title: Germany Offers Bundeswehr Airlift Capacity to Gang Suppression Force
detail: Germany's Bundeswehr (armed forces) offered air transport capacity to support the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force (GSF) in Haiti, HaitiLibre reported August 17, 2026, with equipment and troop-supply flights planned for GSF contributing nations — currently Chad, Sri Lanka, Mongolia, Bangladesh, Guatemala, Côte d'Ivoire, and Haiti — in the coming weeks. The offer adds a European logistics contributor to a force still filling out its authorized 5,550-person ceiling (roughly 1,000 personnel deployed as of the July 20 UN Security Council briefing).

media.caption: Germany offers Bundeswehr airlift support for Gang Suppression Force logistics

title: Opposition Figure André Michel Demands Security Guarantees Before December 13 Vote
detail: Attorney and opposition political figure André Michel issued a public statement August 17, 2026 tying Haiti's OAS/CARICOM-backed transition to concrete security conditions, declaring 'Security is essential for a successful electoral process. The Transition has gone on for too long,' and calling on authorities to restore minimum security levels and unblock national highways before the December 13, 2026 elections. Michel registered to vote in Port-au-Prince and urged supporters to do likewise, reflecting continued political pressure on the Fils-Aimé government and GSF to demonstrate tangible security gains ahead of the vote.

media.caption: André Michel calls for restored security and unblocked highways ahead of Dec. 13 elections
